description: This file defines a helper class for working with WebDAV responses in a web application. It provides methods to create various WebDAV XML elements, prepare HTTP responses, and serialize XML documents for WebDAV interactions within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ResponseHelper
classes.description: A utility class for generating WebDAV-compliant XML responses, including methods for creating elements, preparing responses, and outputting XML documents.

methods.name: prepareResponse
methods.description: Sets up the HTTP response with content type, character encoding, and status/error based on parameters.

methods.name: createElementSetValue
methods.description: Creates an XML element with a given name and text value, within the DAV namespace.

methods.name: createHrefElement
methods.description: Creates a DAV href element with the specified URL.

methods.name: createMultiStatusElement
methods.description: Creates a DAV multistatus XML element.

methods.name: createResponseDescriptionElement
methods.description: Creates a response description element, optionally with language attribute.

methods.name: createResponseElement
methods.description: Creates a DAV response XML element.

methods.name: createStatusElement
methods.description: Creates a status element with the provided status text.

methods.name: getResponseDocument
methods.description: Returns the current XML Document being built.

methods.name: writeResponse
methods.description: Serializes the XML document to the response output stream.
